channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Is the world experiencing more earthquakes now than before?
item.description: Al Jazeera examines a decade of earthquake data to see how 2026 compares and explains how and where earthquakes strike.

item.title: Iraqi Kurdish PM Barzani’s office targeted in drone attack
item.description: Explosive drones target Iraqi Kurdish PM's office and security chief's residence; no casualties reported.

item.title: At least six people killed in Ukrainian missile attack on Russia’s Belgorod
item.description: Overnight Russian missile and drone attacks across Ukraine kill two people and injure 19.

item.title: Iran’s top negotiator declares victory in war against the US and Israel
item.description: Iran’s Parliament speaker and negotiator Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf has declared both a military and political victory

item.title: Rare Pallas’s cat captured on camera in northern Iran mountains
item.description: Footage shows a rare sighting of one of Iran’s most elusive wild felines.

item.title: Trump says US to reduce military drills with South Korea after it stayed out of Iran war
item.description: Trump cites his "very good relationship" with North Korea's leader in deciding to downsize the exercises.

item.title: Trump envoy Kushner meets Netanyahu after Hamas talks on peace plan
item.description: US President Trump's son-in-law Jared Kushner is seeking to gain Israeli backing for the US-backed Gaza peace plan.

item.title: Aid shortages and fears of starvation as Indonesia reels from deadly earthquake
item.description: Some 53 people were killed and thousands displaced by the earthquake, which struck early on Saturday.

item.title: Twelve killed as Polish bus veers off Hungarian motorway
item.description: Dozens more are seriously injured after the tourist bus overturned in the early hours of Sunday morning.

item.title: Thousands displaced by deadly Indonesia earthquake as rescue efforts continue
item.description: Hundreds of homes and public buildings have been severely damaged with at least 53 people killed.
